title: List running lanes and stop them by PID on drop
body:
Source: t-tpkc9xz trial (e), .krn/runs/research/rss-trials/a-e.md
Outcome: krn lane list prints one row per live lane worktree (slug, task id, branch, claim owner, PID alive, PR state); krn lane drop SLUG stops the recorded lane PID before removing the worktree.
Proof: node --test test/cli lane test with a stand-in KRN_LANE_CLAUDE that sleeps: list shows it alive, drop stops it by PID and removes the worktree, exit 0.
